prompt.en: Where are the ancestors of Aboriginal peoples believed to have migrated from?
prompt.fr: D'où les ancêtres des peuples autochtones auraient-ils migré?

options.en: From Asia, many thousands of years ago.
options.fr: D'Asie, il y a plusieurs milliers d'années.

options.en: From Europe, about a thousand years ago.
options.fr: D'Europe, il y a environ mille ans.

options.en: From South America, after the arrival of Europeans.
options.fr: D'Amérique du Sud, après l'arrivée des Européens.

explanation.en: The ancestors of Aboriginal peoples are believed to have migrated from Asia many thousands of years ago — long before any explorer from Europe reached North America.
explanation.fr: On croit que les ancêtres des peuples autochtones ont migré d'Asie il y a plusieurs milliers d'années, bien avant qu'un explorateur européen n'atteigne l'Amérique du Nord.

source.quote: The ancestors of Aboriginal peoples are believed to have migrated from Asia many thousands of years ago.

verification.evidence: The ancestors of Aboriginal peoples are believed to have migrated from Asia many thousands of years ago. They were well established here long before explorers from Europe first came to North America.
